children: Maple Finance hosts its Q3 Ecosystem Update Call live on X on October 13, 2026, at 11:00 ET. The quarterly update presents Q3 results and the first quarter of rules-based SYRUP buybacks under MIP-021, followed by a fireside conversation with Henri Arslanian and a Q&A.

The buyback report connects MIP-021's rules-based program with reported activity, providing a direct read on token supply reduction. Q3 results provide the accompanying view of protocol fundamentals. Actual buyback volume and results remain unestablished until disclosure, so the call's announcement alone does not establish how much SYRUP was repurchased.
Maple's goal is to become the credit and yield layer for a growing stablecoin economy.
will show how we get there, starting with Q3 results and the first quarter of rules-based buybacks under MIP-021.

title: Maple Finance: Hosts Q3 Ecosystem Update Call - 13 Oct 2026
